props.bug: the cap is checked against the supply BEFORE minting (`>=`), not against the supply AFTER minting (`new_supply > CAP`), so the last mint can overshoot the cap.
props.title: Capped mint
props.blurb: A token must never exceed its supply cap of 1000. The cap is checked against the supply before minting, so the last mint can overshoot.
